author: Joe Marion
text:
Allen’s Environmental came out and pumped the septic tanks at both of my houses and did a great job.

He was quick to respond, showed up fast, and got everything taken care of without any hassle. Really appreciated how easy he was to work with and how quickly he got us scheduled. Definitely recommend if you need septic service in East Tennessee.

author: jeff jones
text: Bill was amazing again. I used him 9 years ago at my house and today May 2026 at my mom’s house. Such a blessing thank you for taking this CRAPY DAY into a PARTY!

author: Mumu Xi
text: Super fast and efficient. I made the call in the afternoon and the job was done within 2 hours. Good price too. Will definitely use again

author: Elizabeth Wiseman
text: My new preferred vendor. Bill was highly knowledgeable and went above and beyond to try to help with a complex problem. Highly recommend

author: Joe Matteo
text: Bill Allen does a great job maintaining the septic system at our mountain home.  He is a pleasure to work with and always prompt, professional, and knowledgeable.  He has a custom truck for small mountain roads that makes the process safer and easier, it’s a game changer for our home.  Bill also has advised us on root infiltration and we have been successful keeping them under control.  We highly recommend Allen’s Environmental.
